senses.gloss: m. a. fem. (= דֵּךְ, with אִי prosth.) this, that, freq. the other, another.
units: <cite ref="Yevamot 62a:8">Yeb. 62ᵃ</cite>; a. fr. <he>תניא א׳</he> another (author or Boraitha) teaches.
B. Mets. 98ᵇ וא׳ לא ידענא and as to the other (cow), I don’t know; a. fr.—Pl. אִידֵּי.—א׳ וא׳ these and those, i.e. both.
